# If there's time: split the data {.divider background-color="#CC0000"}

## Split the data {#bonus-split}

```{=html}
<pre class="type diagram" style="width:auto; font-size:0.55em; margin:8px 0 18px; padding:20px 18px">from multiprocessing import Pool
from fire import count_band

size = 8000                                     <span style="color:#A9A9A9"># one forest, 64 million cells</span>
bands = [(size, 0.6, 1, first, 500) for first in range(0, size, 500)]

with Pool() as pool:
    counts = pool.map(count_band, bands)        <span style="color:#A9A9A9"># each worker builds and counts its own bands</span>
total = sum(counts)                             <span style="color:#A9A9A9"># combine once, at the end</span>
</pre>
```
